svg.title: NinaPro DB2: Aligned Windows and Independent Person Splits
svg.desc: Executed 40-person E1 source inventory, deterministic paired-window selection, feature extraction and participant-disjoint Development/Test assignment. The middle panel shows how the signal is processed.
svg.text: NINAPRO DB2: ALIGNED WINDOWS AND INDEPENDENT PERSON SPLITS
40 participants · 337,853 eligible source windows · 40,000 retained pairs · No model fitting
Corrected E1 source timeline → label-pure windows
Illustrative signal crops, not a new filtering operation. Counts and feature dimensions are observed outputs.
Original E1 data → source-safe paired windows → selected modelling cohort → features → person-disjoint evaluation
